🔄 Content Updated (Published: September 21, 2026 / Previous: May 29, 2026)

Main changes: Date changed from July 22 to November 20; meeting place changed from City Hall to Koiwai Water Purification Plant; meeting time changed from 10:00 to 9:00 a.m.; total duration changed from approximately 3.5 hours to approximately 6 hours; fee changed from ¥200 to ¥100; application deadline changed from July 18 to November 13; application contact updated.


We are holding a "Seasonal Walking" event featuring a tour of Koiwai Water Purification Plant and a hike on Kashiwagi Mountain.

【Event Details】
Date: Friday, November 20, 2026 (Reiwa 8)
Meeting time: 9:00 a.m.
Meeting place: Koiwai Water Purification Plant
Route: Koiwai Water Purification Plant → Facility tour → Enosaka junction → Kashiwagi Mountain summit (lunch break) → Akane Pass → Akane Plateau distribution reservoir grounds → Koiwai Water Purification Plant
Distance: Approximately 10 kilometers
Duration: Approximately 6 hours

【Fee & What to Bring】
Fee: ¥100 (insurance, collected on the day)
Bring: Beverages, boxed lunch, rain gear, Sugo-Ashi handbook (if you have one)

【Registration】
Capacity: 30 people
Application period: October 5 (Monday) to November 13 (Friday)
To apply, contact Haraichiba District Administrative Center by phone (042-977-1232), fax (042-977-0582), or email (hara-center@city.hanno.lg.jp).

【Getting There & Weather Info】
To reach Koiwai Water Purification Plant: Get off at Hanno Second Elementary School bus stop and walk approximately 15 minutes.
Weather: The event may be cancelled due to weather conditions. To check for cancellation on the day, contact Haraichiba District Administrative Center between 7:00–7:30 a.m.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/12784.html
summary: ℹ️ Sugo-Ashi Walking Event – November 20, 2026 (Friday): Seasonal Walk with Koiwai Water Purification Plant Tour and Kashiwagi Mountain Autumn Hike
